question: In what ways will the implementation of this Act affect the workload, training requirements, and operational protocols of CBP personnel responsible for utilizing and maintaining the newly integrated technologies?

This will likely increase the workload for CBP personnel responsible for these tasks. (H.R. 7832, Sec. 2(b)(1), (6))

Third, the Act authorizes the Commissioner of CBP to maintain one or more CBP Innovation Teams to research and adapt commercial technologies. These teams will likely require personnel to work on their projects, which may involve new operational protocols and potentially different work environments. (H.R. 7832, Sec. 2(c))

Lastly, the Act requires CBP to phase out and replace legacy border technology programs with technologies referred to in the Act. This will likely involve training CBP personnel on the new technologies and updating operational protocols to incorporate them. (H.R. 7832, Sec. 2(b)(9))

There is no specific provision in the Act that directly addresses training requirements for CBP personnel. However, given the nature of the technologies to be integrated and the need to address privacy and security concerns, it is reasonable to assume that additional training will be necessary.
